answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the yarrow of a task receipt, and the garden is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. What survives to the nadir is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
